components.name: Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells
components.reasoning: These are the fundamental photovoltaic elements that convert sunlight into electrical energy; they are universally present as an assembled unit in all monocrystalline solar panels.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: A critical protective layer for the front of the panel that transmits light while safeguarding cells against environmental damage; procured as a standardized sheet unique to module fabrication.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: Provides structural integrity and mounting points; widely used as a separate, purchasable assembly across nearly all solar panel designs.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: An electrical interface for wiring connections and contains bypass diodes; it is a distinct component with its own supply chain and is always attached to the module back.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA)
components.reasoning: Encapsulants such as ethylene-vinyl acetate sheets protect and bond cells between glass and backsheet; typically sourced from specialized manufacturers and handled as a separate component.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: Serves as the rear protective layer providing electrical insulation and environmental resistance; often procured as a distinct polymer sheet or film in module assembly.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Monocrystalline silicon photovoltaic (PV) module typically configured as framed solar panels with laminated PV cells encapsulated between glass and backsheet layers.
